overrideNotes.defu: Pin to 6.1.6 to mitigate GHSA-737v-mqg7-c878 / CVE-2026-35209: replace the vulnerable transitive deep-merge helper.
overrideNotes.@xmldom/xmldom: Pin to 0.8.13 to mitigate GHSA-f6ww-3ggp-fr8h, GHSA-2v35-w6hq-6mfw, GHSA-j759-j44w-7fr8, and GHSA-x6wf-f3px-wcqx: keep Expo plist tooling on the patched 0.8.x line.
overrideNotes.fast-xml-parser: Pin to 5.7.2 to mitigate GHSA-gh4j-gqv2-49f6 in XMLBuilder comment/CDATA serialization while keeping transitive feed and storage XML tooling on the patched 5.x line.
overrideNotes.fast-xml-builder: Pin to 1.2.0 to mitigate two Dependabot alerts on the version that fast-xml-parser@5.7.2 pulls in transitively: the high-severity attribute-quote bypass (alert #162, fixed 1.1.7) and the medium-severity comment-regex bypass (alert #161, fixed 1.1.6). 1.2.0 is the latest published. fast-xml-parser declares fast-xml-builder ^1.1.5 so this override stays inside its accepted semver range. Exact pin matches the convention for CVE-motivated overrides in this file.
overrideNotes.fast-uri: Pin to 3.1.2 to mitigate two high-severity Dependabot alerts on the 3.1.0 transitive of ajv@8.18.0: GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc (alert #164, host confusion via percent-encoded authority delimiters, fixed 3.1.2) and the path-traversal-via-percent-encoded-dot-segments advisory (alert #163, fixed 3.1.1). ajv 8.x has no fast-uri peer constraint so the override is safe. Exact pin matches the convention for CVE-motivated overrides in this file.
overrideNotes.std-env: Pin to 4.1.0 so Vitest 4.x can import isAgent from a compatible std-env release.
overrideNotes.tinyrainbow: Pin to 3.1.0 so Vitest 4.x consumers resolve a compatible color utility during CLI startup.
overrideNotes.postcss: Pin to 8.5.10 to mitigate GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 in CSS stringify output.
overrideNotes.uuid@<7: Preserve the existing legacy uuid guard for pre-7 consumers while keeping Expo xcode@3.0.1 on its CommonJS-compatible uuid@7.0.3 resolution.
overrideNotes.uuid@>=11 <11.1.1: Pin uuid 11.x consumers to 11.1.1 to mitigate GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq while preserving CommonJS compatibility.
overrideNotes.uuid@>=12 <12.0.1: Pin uuid 12.x consumers to 12.0.1 to mitigate GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq.
overrideNotes.uuid@>=13 <13.0.1: Pin uuid 13.x consumers to 13.0.1 to mitigate GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq.
overrideNotes.ip-address: Pin to 10.2.0 to mitigate GHSA-v2v4-37r5-5v8g via transitive Lighthouse/Puppeteer proxy tooling.
overrideNotes.axios: Pin to 1.16.0 to mitigate the GHSA-w9j2-pvgh-6h63 / GHSA-pmwg-cvhr-8vh7 / GHSA-6chq-wfr3-2hj9 advisory cluster affecting axios versions before 1.15.1.
overrideNotes.sanitize-html: Pin to 2.17.4 to mitigate GHSA-rpr9-rxv7-x643 / CVE-2026-44990: prevent xmp raw-text passthrough from rehydrating attacker-controlled markup after sanitization.
overrideNotes.langsmith: Pin to 0.6.0 to mitigate GHSA-3644-q5cj-c5c7: keep CopilotKit/LangChain prompt-pull behavior on the patched JS trust-boundary release without a broad CopilotKit upgrade.
overrideNotes.next: Pin to 16.2.4 to mitigate GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3 in Server Components.
overrideNotes.basic-ftp: Pin to 5.3.1 to mitigate GHSA-rpmf-866q-6p89 / CVE-2026-44240 (unbounded multiline control-response buffering DoS) and the prior GHSA-rp42-5vxx-qpwr, both via transitive Lighthouse tooling.
overrideNotes.ajv@<6.14.0: Pin legacy AJV 6 consumers to 6.14.0 to mitigate GHSA-2g4f-4pwh-qvx6 without forcing AJV 8 into older consumers.
overrideNotes.@types/react: Dedupe to a single version. Without this, pnpm hoists 19.2.13 at the root and nested copies at 19.2.14, causing TS2769 'two different types with this name' errors on react-native ref props.
overrideNotes.@firebase/util: Dedupe to a single version. Two transitive consumers (@firebase/database-compat 2.1.0 vs 2.1.1) pull in @firebase/util 1.13.0 and 1.14.0 simultaneously; under node-linker=hoisted the second copy goes into nested node_modules/@firebase/database-types/node_modules/ and pnpm 10.28 races its own extraction there, failing with ENOENT on the temp-file rename. Reproduced in storefront Android runs 25457441264 and the 2026-05-01 466a00fc86 run.
overrideNotes.mermaid: Pin to ^11.15.0 to close GHSA-6m6c-36f7-fhxh (Gantt-chart infinite-loop DoS), GHSA-87f9-hvmw-gh4p (CSS injection via configuration), GHSA-ghcm-xqfw-q4vr (HTML injection in classDef state diagrams), and GHSA-xcj9-5m2h-648r (CSS injection in classDefs). All four advisories fixed in 11.15.0. mermaid arrives here transitively via streamdown 1.6.11 (markdown streaming for the AI chat rendering pipeline).
overrideNotes.protobufjs: Pin to 7.6.0 to close the 7.x CVE set, including GHSA-jggg-4jg4-v7c6 / CVE-2026-45740 for unbounded recursive JSON descriptor expansion. This preserves the protobufjs 7 major while moving beyond the prior 7.5.6 override, which became vulnerable.
overrideNotes.@protobufjs/utf8: Pin to 1.1.1 to close GHSA-mm78-2hpw-9j97 (overlong UTF-8 decoding allows mis-encoded sequences through). 1.1.0 is the vulnerable transitive that the legacy protobufjs 6.x consumers still drag in; 1.1.1 is the patched release.
overrideNotes.brace-expansion: Pin to 5.0.6 to mitigate GHSA-jxxr-4gwj-5jf2 / CVE-2026-45149: enforce documented max limits before large numeric range expansion allocates the full intermediate array.
overrideNotes.ws@>=8 <8.20.1: Pin vulnerable ws 8.x consumers to 8.20.1 to mitigate GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx / CVE-2026-45736 without forcing older ws 7.x consumers across a major version.
